valid_regions.0: main Session image in Chip-RAM Bank 3
valid_regions.1: bounded Session overflow in C2D-owned Chip-RAM Bank 5

main.contents: catalog, directory and normal Session path

rollback_overflow.contents: rollback wipe-plane, wipe-chip and wipe-attic bodies only; rollback-unpublish remains in the main Session region

loading.payload_source: absolute source_addr consumed directly by the region-blind hot loader
loading.source_resolution: emitter/stage resolves region_id to source_addr exactly once
loading.stage_bounds: the canonical emitter rejects every region-qualified source outside its packed region; the emitted record CRC binds region_id and source_addr
loading.stage_target_identity: the final family-manifest size/CRC tuple is published into rtov_family_stage_bindings; the cold family stage proves the complete target image, including region 1 for Session, before RTOV_FAMILY_VERIFIED
loading.runtime_record_validation: record CRC convergence authenticates the emitted tuple at use; duplicate region/source bounds reconstruction in the per-record verifier is forbidden
loading.installer_frame_order: the authenticated v4 slot/count tuple is transformed to its final absolute source bank/megabyte representation before the verifier computes or publishes the installer-frame seal
loading.installer_frame_identity: the original Boot installer slot identity is consumed from the CRC-bound record; the transformed frame contains only the final representation consumed by the installer
loading.region1_lifetime_order: the product shelf may use Bank 5 at 0xbd00 during boot; only after phase 03 has consumed the shelf may the cold Session stager copy Region 1 from its disjoint durable Attic source into that destination

batch_repeat.replacement: each requested repetition traverses vm_runtime_overlay_exec and therefore the complete authenticated single-record copy, target-CRC, execute and wipe path
batch_repeat.deliberate_cost: cold L65M, commit and LCC batch operations repeat record authentication and transport and are therefore slower
batch_repeat.forbidden: same-payload Island loop, hidden batch fast path or fallback that bypasses single-record verification

tuple_lifetime_guards.rtov_batch_entry_and_rtov_batch_crc: serial split-installer handoff or transaction-auth catalog tuple only
tuple_lifetime_guards.rtov_batch_slot_id: transaction-auth catalog tuple, fixed retry probe result or non-transaction-auth C1 abort result only

record_source_verification.emitter_authority: runtime_overlay_bank.py validates exact absolute source addresses against the packed region geometry
record_source_verification.binding: L65R-v4 record CRC covers region_id and every absolute source-address byte
record_source_verification.stage_authority: the final manifest size/CRC is consumed by the cold target stage and must match the complete staged image before family publication
record_source_verification.hot_path: consumes only the authenticated absolute source tuple

session_emitter_state.home: c2e_work_state in the existing 304-byte phase scratch

gates.packing: each record is bounded within its named region
gates.closure: every loaded Session record has exactly one authenticated region
gates.staging: region 1 is copied from the disjoint 0x08300000 durable source only after shelf consumption, then target-verified before Session family publication
gates.c2d_floor: no C2D growth or journal write reaches 0xbd00
E000_S1: both retired batch symbols absent from the final ELF
every repeated iteration calls the complete single-record loader
invalid policy or absent predicate retains the single-record behavior
stage_source_authority: record CRC binds region and source
final manifest size/CRC binds the staged family
target CRC and region-1 CRC precede RTOV_FAMILY_VERIFIED
runtime verifier contains no duplicate region dispatch or source-bounds reconstruction
post_shelf_region1: durable Region-1 source is 0x08300000 and disjoint from Session main, product shelf and Boot family
phase 03 precedes the cold Region-1 copy
the Link-61 hardware state with an L65S shelf prefix at Bank 5 is a permanent publication-negative fixture
v4_installer_frame_seal: record verifier authenticates the final record bytes
slot/count transform to absolute source bank/megabyte
seal covers the transformed frame through offsetof(rtov_verify_context, seal)
installer recomputes the same sealed domain before installation
